subject: SIG/CAIQ: encryption lifecycle artifacts delivery for HorizonBank
messages:
From: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security@horizonbank.com
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ encryption lifecycle evidence / HSM attestation

Hi Markus,

We are finalizing the SIG/CAIQ and need a concise bundle showing Redwood's encryption lifecycle controls for the tenant we plan to onboard (HorizonBank-prod). Specifically the security team has asked for: 

- KMS key rotation logs covering the last 12 months (rotation events and initiating principal)
- HSM attestation or vendor-signed seal demonstrating FIPS 140-2/3 compliance
- Evidence that data is encrypted in transit (TLS version/cipher policy and any mTLS usage)
- A short narrative of how BYOK/tenant-managed keys would change the artifact set

Can you share a recommended delivery mechanism (SFTP/secure Share link) and a target ETA? SOC 2 questionnaire owners will be on a tight timeline.

Thanks,
Darya
Darya Ivanov
Senior InfoSec Manager — HorizonBank

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ encryption lifecycle evidence / HSM attestation

Hi Darya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all of that. Proposed plan: 

1) Rotation logs: CSV export with timestamp, key_id, rotation_type (scheduled/manual/rollback), initiating_principal (service_account or user), and checksum. We will redact service account ids where required and include a mapping file.
2) HSM attestation: vendor-signed PDF attestation (latest) plus our internal verification checklist.
3) Transit: TLS policy snapshot and trace of a sample TLS handshake showing cipher suites negotiated; mTLS details where enabled for Dedicated tenants.
4) BYOK note: short one-page summary describing differences (customer KMS responsibilities, sealed-wrapping, handoff).

Delivery: secure SFTP host (sftp.redwood-internal-transfer.com) with one-time credentials, SHA256 manifest, and manifest signature. If you prefer a Drive link we can encrypt zip with a passphrase transmitted out-of-band.

ETA: I can stage the rotation logs + transit artifacts by EOD 2028-04-03 and the HSM attestation (signed by the vendor) by 2028-04-04. Does that timeline work for you?

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ encryption lifecycle evidence / HSM attestation

Markus — that timeline works. Two follow-ups: 

1) Could you include a sample rotation event showing key material ancestry (wrap/unwrap operation ids) for one tenant key? We only need a redacted example that preserves the operation id and timestamp chain.
2) For transit proof, we need a small pcap-equivalent transcript (ASCII TLS handshake extract) rather than a full pcap.

SFTP is fine. Please send credentials to security@horizonbank.com and copy me.

Thanks,
Darya

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ encryption lifecycle evidence / HSM attestation

Hi Darya — scheduling note from ops: we will open an SFTP drop for horizonbank-evidence-2028-04 with a one-time user. Credentials will expire in 72 hours after upload. Attached manifest will contain SHA256 checksums for each file.

For the rotation example: see below attached CSV row (redacted) and a minimal ancestry trace in the manifest. I have included the sample transcript for TLS handshake as a text extract. Full attachments are in the SFTP drop once uploaded.

Attachment stubs referenced: horizonbank_kms-rotation-log.csv (CSV, redacted sample), sftp_delivery_manifest.txt

Laura Bennett
Security Operations — Redwood Inference

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>, security@horizonbank.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-04T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ encryption lifecycle evidence / HSM attestation

Darya — uploaded the initial bundle to SFTP (horizonbank-evidence-2028-04). What is included in the root of the drop: 

- horizonbank_kms-rotation-log.csv (redacted 12-month export; see sample row below)
- rotation_ancestry_example.txt (single-key operation chain: create -> rotate -> wrap -> rotate)
- tls_handshake_extract.txt (ASCII TLS handshake transcript; cipher TLS1.3_AES_128_GCM_SHA256)
- sftp_delivery_manifest.txt (SHA256 checksums + signed manifest)

Sample CSV row (redacted):
2028-03-05T02:14:11Z,k-9a7f2e,scheduled,svc-redwood-ops,rotate,op-7b3f2c

Irene is coordinating HSM vendor for the attestation; we expect the signed PDF later today. Please confirm once download completes so we can record delivery in HubSpot (0012345).

-Markus

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-04T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: HSM attestation and verification checklist (attached)

Hi Darya,

Attached: hsm_attestation_2028-03-28.pdf (vendor-signed), hsm_verification_checklist.txt (internal verification steps and hash of attestation). Key points: 
- HSM vendor: CryptoVault Inc., module certified FIPS 140-3 Level 3 (cert reference included in PDF).
- Attestation includes serial numbers, firmware hashes, and a notarized snapshot of module maintenance events through 2028-03-28.
- Our verification checklist confirms the attestation signature and records the SHA256 of the vendor PDF.

If you need a notarized chain or the vendor contact for direct attestation queries, I can introduce you.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Applied Security — Redwood Inference

From: Darya Ivanov <darya.ivanov@horizonbank.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, security@horizonbank.com
Date: 2028-04-06T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: encryption lifecycle artifacts delivery for HorizonBank

Team — we downloaded and validated the manifest and sample artifacts. A couple of clarifications before we close the ticket: 

1) The rotation CSV contains service account ids; thank you for providing the mapping file. We verified the operation ids and timestamps.
2) The TLS transcript demonstrates TLS 1.3 with AES-GCM ciphers — acceptable. 
3) HSM attestation: the vendor PDF is in order; we may reach out to CryptoVault for a short clarifying question on firmware build dates, but this looks fine for SIG.

Please log the HubSpot delivery note (HubSpot: 0012345) and mark the SIG evidence as delivered to HorizonBank SOC team. We may follow up if the vendor responds with additional material.

Best,
Darya
Senior InfoSec Manager — HorizonBank
